name: Heart no Kakera
source:
Sakurai Masato just entered high school. He starts to feel dissatisfaction with current life and starts club activity. What kind of girls can he meet?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
樱井雅人刚升入高中。他开始对现在的生活感到不满，于是加入了社团活动。他会遇到什么样的女孩呢？

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1997.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
